name: typesafe-ai-benchmark
description: Benchmark LLM-native structured output from Qwen 3.8 on Cerebras against TypeSafe Jev.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @decision/gateway && npm run build -w @decision/decisions && npm run dev -w @decision/theater
scripts.dev:live: npm run build -w @decision/gateway && npm run build -w @decision/decisions && npm run dev:live -w @decision/theater
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @decision/gateway && npm run build -w @decision/gateway && npm run typecheck -w @decision/decisions && npm run build -w @decision/decisions && npm run typecheck -w @decision/theater
scripts.test: npm run build -w @decision/gateway && npm run build -w @decision/decisions && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build -w @decision/gateway && npm run build -w @decision/decisions && npm run build -w @decision/theater
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
